{{E|Cursed Tome}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 2]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Read}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Continue}} {{TS|negative||Lose 1 HP.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Continue}} {{TS|negative||Lose 2 HP.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Continue}} {{TS|negative||Lose 3 HP.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Take}} {{TS|positive||Obtain the book.}} {{TS|negative||Lose 10}} {{asc|15|(15)}} {{TS|negative||HP.}}
* The book may be {{R|Enchiridion}}, {{R|Nilry's Codex}}, or {{R|Necronomicon}}. The player does not know which book they will get until after they choose {{Frame|Take}} and lose their HP.
<br>
{{Frame|Stop}} {{TS|negative||Lose 3 HP.}}
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

=== Practical Options ===
Because the player can choose to leave the event immediately and lose 0 HP instead of selecting {{Frame|Continue}} 3 times and then backing out with {{Frame|Stop}} while losing a total of 9 HP, there are really only 2 practical ways to navigate the event. The player can either commit to all the HP loss and obtain the book, or leave immediately to do nothing.

For simplicity, the event's options can be thought of in this way instead:
* {{Frame|Read}}, then all 3 {{Frame|Continue}}, and finally {{Frame|Take}} {{TS|positive||Obtain the book.}} {{TS|negative||Lose 16}} {{asc|15|(21)}} {{TS|negative||HP.}} 
* {{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
In an abandoned temple, you find a giant book, open, riddled with {{TS|purple|shake|cryptic writings.}} <br>

As you try to interpret the elaborate script, it begins to {{TS|blue|up|shift}} and {{TS|blue|up|morph}} into writing you are familiar with.
</div>
<br>
{{Frame|Read}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Odd. The book seems to be about an {{TS|gold||Ancient}} named {{TS|gold||Neow.}} <br>

This piques your interest, but you have a general feeling of {{TS|purple|up|malaise.}}
</div>

{{Frame|Continue}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The Ancient of Resurrection, {{TS|gold||Neow,}} was exiled to the bottom of the Spire. <br>

You feel compelled to read more, but your body begins to {{TS|negative|up|ache.}}
</div>

{{Frame|Continue}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Seeking vengeance, {{TS|gold||Neow}} blesses outsiders, using them for her own purposes. <br>

You are starting to feel very {{TS|negative|up|weak and tired...}}
</div>

{{Frame|Continue}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Those resurrected by {{TS|gold||Neow}} remember only fragments of their past selves, cursed to fight for eternity. <br>

As you near the final page, your {{TS|negative|shake|old wounds begin to reopen!}}
</div>

{{Frame|Take}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Upon finishing the tome, you decide to take it with you. With proof in hand, will you retain your memories?
</div></blockquote>
{{Frame|Stop}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
With incredible strain and willpower, you resist the trance of the tome and {{TS||shake|SLAM}} it shut. <br>
You turn and exit the temple, feeling {{TS|blue|up|drained...}}
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You exit, feeling a {{TS|purple|up|dark energy emanating}} from the book on the pedestal.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* {{R|Tungsten Rod}} will reduce the HP lost for each instance of damage from the event's options. If the player selects {{Frame|Continue}} 3 times and then {{Frame|Take}}, {{R|Tungsten Rod}} reduces the total HP lost by 4 for a total of 12 {{Asc|15|(17)}} HP lost instead of 16 {{Asc|15|(21)}}.
** If the player selects {{Frame|Stop}} instead of {{Frame|Take}}, {{R|Tungsten Rod}} reduces the total HP lost to 5 instead of 9.

* '''Weekly Patch 16: Back to Work'''
